reason: The primary CIF parses cleanly and symmetry-expands in Immm to fully occupied Li6Au8O8 (22 atoms, Z = 2), reducing to a primitive 11-atom Li3Au4O4 cell with the reported conventional cell and ordering. The I-orthorhombic cell indexes all 20 initial lines with M(20) = 138.5, and an independent audit matches every observed reflection of prominence at least 0.7 within 0.019 degrees, with no important unexplained peak. The instantiated coordinates give integrated-intensity R = 2.87% and correlation = 0.99925; the trace's profile RMSE of 0.2166 is close to its Pawley-like lower bound of about 0.2048. Explicit site searches isolate Au 8n and O 4g+4e by large fit margins, and Li 4f+2b remains best among the tested multiplicity-compatible orderings; the closest 4f+2d branch is profile-inferior and has an approximately 1.67 angstrom Li-O contact, while 4f+2a and the other assignments are quantitatively worse. Periodic geometry has no overlaps (minimum distance about 1.821 angstrom), with plausible complete Au-O and Li-O shells. No concrete viable incompatible ordering, symmetry-lowered model, occupancy variant, or superstructure remains unsupported by the submitted set.
